verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sentry serves an llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Sentry Documentation header). Sentry also documents agent-oriented guidance: one command 'teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok' to install and configure Sentry, and its MCP server lets assistants read documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt content's depth or coverage beyond its header, and first-party docs or independent hands-on reports describing agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.sentry.io/llms.txt # Sentry Documentation
One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
